installs: 8 SKILL.md skill directories under skills/ in three categories (development, documentation, security), 8 agent definitions under agents/ carried both as agents/<name>.md and as agents/<name>/agent.md, 133 further subagent definitions as agent.md files under subagents/, 24 slash-command Markdown files under commands/, and 6 prompt templates, 11 standards documents, and 10 worked examples under prompts/, standards/, and examples/. scripts/install.sh copies skills/, commands/, and agents/ into ~/.claude/skills/, ~/.claude/commands/, and ~/.claude/agents/, where Claude Code discovers them, and the remaining documents into ~/claude-code-resources/; the README documents the same copies by hand.
distribution_machinery: scripts/install.sh backs up an existing ~/.claude/ directory, creates the discovery directories, and copies the pack's documents into them, with --skills-only, --commands-only, --agents-only, and --resources-only selectors; scripts/update.sh refreshes an existing install. commitlint.config.js is the repository's own commit tooling and is not installed.
not_a_system: Owns no state it reads back and does no enforced work: everything installed is Markdown that Claude Code reads and executes with its own tools, and the only code it ships copies those files into the host's discovery directories.
